thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: per-tenant observability gap detected for tenant=NovaBank (dedicated-pool us-west-2). Symptoms: missing traces in tracing-backend, logs absent from log-silo-novabank, metrics appear under generic pool shard. Impact: customer reports inability to correlate requests -> higher MTTR. Auto-run checks failed on forwarder auth (403). Paging SRE rota now. Incident ID: INC-1768004321. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1768004321

maria.sre: Ack — taking lead. Can someone paste the recent forwarder logs and confirm whether this started with the deploy at ~1768002000? (I'll stand up a call if we need to) :phone:

dmitri.monitoring: Quick summary from monitoring side: we see a spike in forwarder auth failures starting 1768002887, matching a config roll that changed destination mapping for tenant prefixes. Excerpt from forwarder logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-07T19:08:07Z forwarder[pid=84] tenant=novabank dest=log-silo-novabank put=FAIL err=AccessDenied (403) role=forwarder-role-xyz
2026-03-07T19:08:09Z forwarder[pid=84] tenant=novabank dest=global-sink put=OK
```
So the forwarder can reach global-sink but not the tenant-specific sink. IAM role binding for the tenant sink was likely removed in the recent infra rollout.

lee.engineering: If that's true, quick mitigation is to short-circuit NovaBank to global-sink until we restore tenant sink role. Two options: 1) toggle `forwarder.override_destination=global-sink` for that tenant (fast, no infra deploy) or 2) patch forwarder deployment to use proxy sidecar with creds that have tenant-sink access (safer but longer). I can flip the override flag now if ops approves.

ashley.se: +1 for override flag for immediate restoration of visibility — we should communicate to NovaBank that we will temporarily route their logs to the shared sink (no data loss but routing/retention differ). Need to ensure we scrub PII per policy while in global sink. I'll draft the customer message if we go that path.

maria.sre: Ops, temporary override sounds good. Can someone run the toggle and confirm traces/logs reappear? I'll open the conference once we see logs.

ops-oncall: On it. Running toggle for tenant=novabank now. Command (infra CLI):
```
infractl tenant update --id novabank --set forwarder.override_destination=global-sink --reason "incident 1768004321 temporary mitigation"
```
Applying...

ops-oncall: Toggle applied. Waiting for forwarder reconnects (grace period ~10s).

dmitri.monitoring: Seeing reconnects from novabank forwarder. Traces are still missing (tracing backend shows empty for last 5m) but logs are starting to appear in global-sink (indexing latency ~12s). Pushing a quick synthetic tracer:
```
curl -XPOST https://forwarder.internal/ingest -d '{"tenant":"novabank","trace_id":"test-123","spans":[]}'
```
Received 200 and span shows up in logs -> suggests tracing pipeline separate; likely the tracing ingestion role or mapping for novabank trace stream is still broken.

lee.engineering: For traces we need to check the trace-router mapping table (kv-store key: trace:route:novabank). My suspicion: the mapping was overwitten during the same deploy that altered log-sink bindings. Quick fix: set trace:route:novabank -> global-trace-snap for 1h. Command: `kvctl set trace:route:novabank global-trace-snap --ttl 3600`

maria.sre: Please run the kvctl set and confirm. Also ashley, good to prep the customer note. I'm starting a short bridge (link: https://meet.redwood/incident-1768004321).

lee.engineering: Done. `kvctl set` applied at 1768005020.

dmitri.monitoring: Traces start to appear in global-trace-snap within ~18s. Correlation across logs+traces looks restored for novabank now. Monitoring shows error rate in trace ingestion falling back to baseline.

ashley.se: Drafted message to NovaBank (DM + support email) — short, apologetic, and clear: we temporarily routed your telemetry to a shared sink while we restore tenant-specific bindings. No data loss; retention/policy differences noted; we will rotate and audit permissions and share findings. Posting to support channel now. :email:

jordan.support: Posted the customer message to NovaBank contact and opened a support ticket (SUP-4972). Customer acknowledged and is on the bridge. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.

maria.sre: Good. Temporary mitigation = override destination + kv route to global-trace-snap. Who owns the permanent remediation (recreate/verify tenant sink IAM role + runbook to prevent future rollbacks)?

lee.engineering: I'll own the post-incident remediation: tasks: 1) audit infra rollout that removed role binding; 2) add preflight checks for tenant sink IAM bindings to the deploy pipeline; 3) add an automated rollback guard if a deploy changes tenant-sink mapping without human approval. I'll create JIRA INC-1768004321-REM and link to postmortem. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial RCA draft.

dmitri.monitoring: I'll follow up with monitoring changes: add an alert that triggers when tenant-specific sink returns >50% 403s in 5m, and add a dashboard to show tenant routing health.

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll revert the override once we re-provision the tenant sink role and confirm safe handoff (will coordinate with lee).

maria.sre: Handing off to @ops-oncall for follow-through, staying on call with customer for a minute then dropping. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: Handoff received. I'll coordinate the role rebind and schedule a post-incident verification runbook with NovaBank for SAT window. Closing bridge in 10m unless anything else pops up.

maria.sre: (post-bridge) Bridge closed — customer satisfied with temporary mitigation and ETA. Will open postmortem and assign owners as discussed. Action items summarized in incident ticket: rollback guard, deploy preflight, monitoring alert, customer audit, postmortem writeup.

lee.engineering: Created JIRA INC-1768004321-REM and linked support ticket SUP-4972. Assigned to self for remediation.

dmitri.monitoring: I'll add the monitoring alert and a short runbook snippet to the incident ticket.

ashley.se: I'll follow-up with NovaBank with the remediation timeline and offer a security audit.

maria.sre: Thanks all — monitoring will keep an eye on correlations for 2h. Closing thread when verification window passes. :white_check_mark:
